Shaggy, shoulder-length electric yellow hair with messy bangs and a wild texture. The eyes are a light amber shade with a perpetually anxious or surprised expression. The face appears to be in the early twenties with a lean, youthful maturity. The build is slender and lanky. The outfit consists of a deep purple kimono worn loosely over a white undershirt. A signature detail is the presence of a large, ornate gold-colored crystal ball often held in the hands.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
